title: Pricing and credits
description: Only super administrators can edit these nine products. Changes apply to new purchases only; existing orders and subscriptions keep their original price and credit allowance.
stripe_note: Currency, billing intervals and credit expiry policies stay unchanged. A custom monthly price uses a new dynamic Stripe price rather than the default plan's saved Price ID. API keys stay in payment settings.

monthly.title: Monthly subscriptions
monthly.description: Charge once per month. Credits follow the paid billing period.

annual.title: Annual subscriptions
annual.description: Charge the full year up front. Release the configured credit allowance each month, not all at once.

credits.title: Permanent credit packs
credits.description: One-time purchase. These credits never expire.

saved: Pricing saved. New purchases use these prices and credit allowances.
reloaded: Saved values loaded. You can edit them now.
ready: All nine products are saved together. USD prices support up to two decimal places.
reload: Discard edits and load saved values
reload_warning: Loading saved values replaces your unsaved edits. Copy any values you want to keep before continuing.
leave_description: Your unsaved pricing and credit changes will be lost.
leave_pending: A request is still running and may complete on the server. Reload saved values before making another change.

video.title: Video generation credit cost
video.description: Set credits per second by video version, generation mode and resolution. Super administrators only. Save separately from product prices and purchased credits above.
video.policy: Total cost = credits per second × video duration, rounded up once for the whole video. For example, 3.5 × 3 seconds = 11 credits. New tasks use saved rates; existing charges and refunds stay unchanged.
video.ready: All 24 rates are saved together. Existing or default rates apply until saved; save a blank to disable that specification. Wan 2.5 1080P is disabled by default.
video.saved: Video rates saved. New tasks use these rates for quotes and charges.
video.rate_tip: Use whole or half credits, or an exact fraction such as 50/7. Result must be 1–99,999.5; leave blank to disable.
video.environment_override: Read-only environment override. Change or remove the environment variable to use the admin value.
video.invalid_rate: Enter a rate from 1 to 99,999.5, such as 5, 3.5 or 50/7; leave blank to disable.

errors.pricing_environment_override: A rate is controlled by an environment variable. Reload the saved configuration; admin values cannot override the environment.
errors.invalid_price: Enter $0.01–$999,999.99 using up to two decimal places and a decimal point.
errors.invalid_credits: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000,000, without separators.
errors.pricing_invalid: Check the highlighted fields. Pricing has not been changed.
errors.pricing_conflict: Pricing was changed by another administrator. Load the saved values before making another change.
errors.pricing_unknown: These changes may have been saved, but confirmation was not received. Load saved values before saving again.
errors.pricing_unavailable: Could not load saved pricing. Your edits are still here; try loading again when the connection is available.
errors.pricing_forbidden: Only super administrators can change pricing. Your access has changed; these edits were not saved.
errors.pricing_unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again before changing pricing. Keep a copy of any unsaved edits.
